author: cli
text: Re-read 2026-08-17. 'Writes nothing UNLESS cache=True' is not merely still true, it is test-enforced: dig is enrolled in READS in tests/test_read_fence.py, which fingerprints .coord around the call, and a separate assertion requires {viz, dig} to stay in that table. The CACHE HIT paragraph also holds - one rev-parse HEAD to check staleness, and nothing walking history or hitting the forge on a hit. A cache that never checks whether it is stale is a cache that lies; it still checks.
